_comment: Placeholder, non-secret values only for Siri.Workers. Real ConnectionStrings/Redis values belong in `dotnet user-secrets` (dev) or environment variables / Key Vault (prod) — never in this file.

Observability._comment: P0-13 OTLP export, mirrors Siri.Api's appsettings.json. ServiceName is the bare '<project>-<component>' part; Program.cs appends '-<env>' itself. OtlpApiKey (set via env, not here) is the only secret in this section.

Delivery._comment: How queued emails / in-app notifications are delivered. Transport=Database (default) keeps the Hangfire 'email-outbox-send' job polling every minute and needs no broker. Transport=Kafka starts the outbox relay + consumers in this host (and the Hangfire job stands down) - requires the Kafka section below. Everything else here has a working default; see docs/DEPLOYMENT.md 'Kafka' for rollout. No secrets in this section.

Kafka._comment: Only read when Notification:Delivery:Transport=Kafka. BootstrapServers empty = no broker configured. TopicPrefix namespaces every topic and consumer group (give each environment sharing a cluster its own, e.g. siriupskill-dev). Plaintext / SaslPlaintext are accepted in Production only with AllowPlaintext=true (broker reachable solely on a private docker network). SaslUsername / SaslPassword are SECRETS - set Kafka__SaslUsername / Kafka__SaslPassword via the environment (prod) or dotnet user-secrets (dev), never here.

Email._comment: Provider is deliberately EMPTY: no mail is silently dropped. Set Email:Provider=Smtp (+ Email:Smtp:*) to deliver mail; while empty every outbox send fails with email.provider_not_configured and is retried.

Live._comment: P11-03 live classes - must match Siri.Api (this host runs the live-meeting-sync job). Provider: GoogleMeet (default) | ManualOnly | Logging (DEVELOPMENT ONLY; Production refuses to boot with it). PublicBaseUrl defaults to Seo:PublicBaseUrl (set Seo__PublicBaseUrl in the environment). No secrets in this section.

Google._comment: Same OAuth web client as Siri.Api (the job refreshes instructors' tokens and calls Calendar). ClientId empty = Google rooms are OFF. ClientSecret is a SECRET - set Integrations__Google__ClientSecret via the environment (prod) or dotnet user-secrets (dev; this project shares Siri.Api's UserSecretsId), never here.
